description:
Deploy an Etherpad-Lite instance and integrate it with Jitsi Meet to enable collaborative meeting notes. 

1. Deploy a Docker container named 'etherpad' using the 'etherpad/etherpad' image, exposing it on port 9001.
2. Configure Jitsi Meet (likely in /home/ga/jitsi/.env or docker-compose.yml) to use this Etherpad instance. The URL base should be 'http://localhost:9001/p/'.
3. Restart the Jitsi web service to apply changes.
4. Open Firefox, join a meeting room named 'WeeklyStandup', and open the shared document panel.
5. In the shared document, type the following agenda:
   Weekly Standup Agenda - Engineering Team
   1. Previous action items review
   2. Sprint progress update
   3. Blockers and dependencies
   4. New action items
6. Take a screenshot showing the open shared notes panel inside the meeting and save it to '/home/ga/etherpad_integration_proof.png'.
